cases.sentence: Я люблю ___, потому что Он услышал мой голос, мои моления.
cases.explain: The transitive verb люблю (I love) governs the accusative case for its direct object; for animate nouns, this form resembles the genitive.

cases.sentence: Смерть объяла меня своими ___, адские муки постигли меня.
cases.explain: The verb объяла (encircled/surrounded) indicates the instrument or means, requiring the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Смерть объяла меня своими оковами, адские муки постигли меня, я познал ___.
cases.explain: The verb познал (I found/experienced) is transitive and takes the accusative case for its direct object.
The imperative verb избавь (deliver) is transitive and requires the accusative case for its object.

cases.sentence: Господь милостив и праведен, милосерден Бог наш, хранит Господь рабов ___.
cases.explain: The verb хранит (preserves) is transitive and takes the accusative case; for animate adjectives, accusative looks like genitive.

cases.sentence: Возвратись, душа моя, в свой ___, потому что Господь был благ тебе.
cases.explain: After the verb возвратись (return), the preposition в (into) with accusative indicates direction toward a destination.

cases.sentence: Ты избавил ___ мою от смерти, глаза мои от слез и ноги мои от падения.
cases.explain: The verb избавил (delivered) is transitive and takes the accusative case for its direct object.

cases.sentence: Буду ходить перед Господом на ___ живых.
cases.explain: The preposition на (on) indicating location requires the prepositional case.

reading.ru: Я люблю Господа, потому что Он услышал мой голос, мои моления.
reading.question: Why does the psalmist love the Lord?
options: Because the Lord has heard his voice and his prayers
Because the Lord has given him wealth
Because the Lord has made him a king
Because the Lord has protected him from enemies
reading.correct: Because the Lord has heard his voice and his prayers
reading.explain: The text explicitly states 'потому что Он услышал мой голос, мои моления' (because He has heard my voice and my prayers).

reading.ru: Смерть объяла меня своими оковами, адские муки постигли меня, я познал бедствие и скорбь.
reading.question: What afflictions did the psalmist experience?
options: Death surrounded him, the pains of Sheol seized him, and he found trouble and sorrow
He lost his wealth and his family
He was betrayed by his friends
He was imprisoned in a dungeon
reading.correct: Death surrounded him, the pains of Sheol seized him, and he found trouble and sorrow
reading.explain: The text describes these specific afflictions: the cords of death, the pains of Sheol, trouble and sorrow.

reading.ru: Тогда я призвал имя Господне, «О Господи, умоляю Тебя, избавь душу мою».
reading.question: What did the psalmist pray when he was in distress?
options: O Lord, I beg you, deliver my soul
reading.correct: O Lord, I beg you, deliver my soul
reading.explain: The text gives the exact prayer: 'О Господи, умоляю Тебя, избавь душу мою' (O Lord, I beg you, deliver my soul).

reading.ru: Возвратись, душа моя, в свой покой, потому что Господь был благ тебе.
reading.question: Why should the soul return to rest?
options: Because the Lord has been good to it
reading.correct: Because the Lord has been good to it
reading.explain: The text says 'потому что Господь был благ тебе' (because the Lord has been good to you).

reading.ru: Ты избавил душу мою от смерти, глаза мои от слез и ноги мои от падения.
reading.question: What threefold deliverance does the psalmist describe?
options: Deliverance from death, tears, and falling
Deliverance from enemies, hunger, and disease
Deliverance from fear, doubt, and despair
Deliverance from poverty, shame, and exile
reading.correct: Deliverance from death, tears, and falling
reading.explain: The text lists: 'душу мою от смерти, глаза мои от слез и ноги мои от падения' (my soul from death, my eyes from tears, my feet from falling).

reading.ru: Буду ходить перед Господом на земле живых.
reading.question: Where does the psalmist promise to walk?
options: Before the Lord in the land of the living
In the temple of the Lord
In the presence of all nations
reading.correct: Before the Lord in the land of the living
reading.explain: The text says 'Буду ходить перед Господом на земле живых' (I will walk before the Lord in the land of the living).
